title: Palmeiras vs. Vasco U-20 Final to Be Free at Nubank Parque
seoTitle: Palmeiras vs Vasco U-20 Final Free at Nubank Parque
subtitle: Free tickets and facial recognition guarantee stadium access this Friday
excerpt: The decisive Brazilian U-20 Championship match between Palmeiras and Vasco will take place at Nubank Parque with free admission.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Friday (04), the return leg of the Brazilian U-20 Championship final will be played at Nubank Parque, featuring free admission for Palmeiras fans. The event combines free entry, facial recognition, and the new semi-automated offside technology.

Free tickets and CPF reservation

Ticket redemption begins this Thursday (27) at 12 PM on the website ingressospalmeiras.com.br. Each CPF (tax ID) can secure one ticket, and stadium access will be granted via facial recognition. The East Central sector (Gate C) will be open to Palmeiras supporters, while other sections will open according to demand. Visiting fans who are not Palmeiras supporters must purchase a ticket through the same website and enter via Gate D.

Match venue and time

The match takes place at 7 PM (Brasília time) at Nubank Parque, a stadium that already hosted the first leg of the final at São Januário on August 28 at 6 PM, broadcast by SporTV and UOL. Palmeiras enters as the home team, boasting a superior campaign to Vasco's.

Semi-automated offside technology

The duel will also feature semi-automated offside technology, which verifies players' irregular positions and is being tested to create a performance database. The system, already present in Série A since the 20th round, will be used in both U-20 final matches, including the one to be held at Nubank Parque.

Importance of the final for Palmeiras

Palmeiras is playing in the Brazilian U-20 final for the fifth consecutive year and is seeking its third consecutive title. In previous editions, they overcame Cruzeiro, Red Bull Bragantino, Vitória, and Corinthians.

How to get to the stadium

Fans who secure their free ticket must go to Gate C, where facial recognition will take place. Access to the rest of the stadium will be released according to sector occupancy.

With information from Palmeiras, Estadão.
